title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-09-07
description:
Merged 11 ibm security advisories published on 2026-09-07. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7286532, IBM-7286493, IBM-7286490, IBM-7286516, IBM-7286562, IBM-7286563, IBM-7286566, IBM-7286515, IBM-7279347, IBM-7286492, IBM-7286495

Titles:
- IBM App Connect Enterprise is vulnerable to privilege escalation and Denial of Service (CVE-2026-75624)
- IBM Cloud Pak for Data System (CPDS 1.0) is affected by multiple vulnerabilities in various components
- Multiple vulnerabilities affect IBM License Key Server Administration and Reporting Tool and IBM LKS Administration Agent
- Multiple vulnerabilities affect IBM Db2 Warehouse container images.
- DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data has several vulnerabilities due to open source software
- Multiple vulnerabilities affect IBM Db2® on Cloud Pak for Data, and Db2 Warehouse on Cloud Pak for Data.
- IBM Guardium Data Protection is affected by multiple vulnerabilities
- Vulnerabilities exists in cyclops of IBM Netezza Appliance
- Vulnerabilities exists in IBM Netezza Software
